info.title: UniFi Public API
info.description: Production API operations exposed through the public UniFi developer kit. Internal administration, worker, dashboard, support, scheduling, and Falcon orchestration routes are intentionally excluded.

get.description: Lightweight liveness check. It does not test the database, blockchain RPCs, or every downstream dependency.
Runs the deeper service health check, including production dependencies. This operation consumes protected API capacity.

200.description: The API and required dependencies are healthy.

post.description: Creates an API key for the authenticated user. Store the returned value immediately in a server-side secret manager.

get.description: Returns the user's API plan metadata and named API-key records.

delete.description: Deletes the API key identified by its user-scoped name.

example.message: The API key has been deleted successfully.

post.description: Creates a short-lived, single-use challenge for an EVM wallet address.

post.summary: Exchange a signed challenge for a JWT
post.description: Verifies the exact challenge message and signature, consumes the nonce, and returns a bearer JWT.

get.description: Returns the public profile fields available to the authenticated caller.

post.summary: Create or update a user profile
post.description: Sets the supplied profile fields for the authenticated user.

get.summary: Get a wallet address for a chain
get.description: Resolves the user's wallet address for the requested chain.
Returns the user's wallet address for every supported chain protocol.
Returns the formatted net balance for one user, chain, and stablecoin.

get.summary: Get all stablecoin balances on a chain
get.description: Returns formatted balances for every supported stablecoin on the requested chain.

get.summary: Get the complete wallet balance view
get.description: Returns all supported assets across all supported chains, ordered by total USD value.
Returns each supported stablecoin balance and USD value for one chain.
Returns the selected stablecoin's balance and USD value across supported chains.
Returns the user's formatted net balance before creating a payment.
Returns the formatted estimated total stablecoin fee for the selected route.

200.description: Estimated fee denominated in the selected stablecoin.

get.description: Combines spendable balance, estimated fee, and allowance state for the selected route.

post.description: Requests stablecoins for a registered user on a supported public testnet. This operation is not available for mainnet funding.

200.description: A session identifier when requested; otherwise an empty string.

post.description: Submits a payment from a UniFi-managed wallet. The response is a receipt ID; query the receipt endpoint for settlement progress.

get.description: Sends a payment-request notification to the payer identified by the UniFi payment ID.

example.message: Notification sent to Payer on Telegram!

get.description: Returns the latest known state of one stablecoin payment.
Returns a cursor-like page of receipts. Use next_or_previous with the returned has_next and has_prev flags.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of receipts to return.

parameters.name: next_or_previous
parameters.description: true requests the next page; false requests the previous page.

post.description: Creates a short-lived session for the user. Falcon heartbeat settings are optional.

get.description: Returns the user and authentication data associated with a session ID.

bearerAuth.description: Use a server-side UniFi API key or a user JWT issued by the wallet challenge flow.

UserId.name: user_id
UserId.description: UniFi user identifier, such as a verified email address or wallet address.

ApiKeyName.name: name
ApiKeyName.description: User-scoped name for the API key.

CreateSession.name: create_session
CreateSession.description: Whether to create and return a session after funding.

IsFeeInclusive.name: is_fee_incl
IsFeeInclusive.description: When true, the fee is included in the entered amount. When false, the fee is added separately.

PaymentId.name: pid
PaymentId.description: UniFi payment identifier for the payer.

SortByLatest.name: sort_by_latest
SortByLatest.description: Sort newest receipts first when true.

FromStart.name: from_start
FromStart.description: Start a fresh history traversal when true.

BadRequest.description: The request is invalid or cannot be completed in the current state.

Unauthorized.description: The bearer credential is missing, invalid, or not authorized for this user.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist.

Conflict.description: The operation conflicts with the resource's current state.

RateLimited.description: The credential has exceeded its current request allowance.

ServerError.description: The API could not complete the request.

Unavailable.description: A required dependency is temporarily unavailable.

Chain.description: Production-supported mainnets and public testnets exposed by the public reference.

uri.description: Expected application origin or sign-in URI.

message.description: Sign this exact message without modification.

email.description: When present, the address is verified.

WalletBalances.description: Assets ordered by total USD value.

Memo.description: Payment purpose. Unit variants serialize as strings; data-carrying variants serialize as objects.

end_ts_us.description: Confirmation time in microseconds, or zero before confirmation.
